actionable_root_causes_and_fixes.root_cause: tools/bounded_run.sh:23-56 snapshot permits exactly one 200 ms ps acquisition per call and throws on a zero-byte/unreaped helper. signal_owned at :163-170 invokes that fresh snapshot for every signal. The cleanup eval at :210-250 converts the first snapshot exception into cleanup_error/result 125 and exits the normal cleanup path. The emergency loop at :249 only revisits identities already in %stopped, so an escaped child not yet stopped is not guaranteed a final CONT/KILL.
actionable_root_causes_and_fixes.actual_outcome: In /tmp/7ad-q32L0NLY/results.json the runner logged interrupted INT followed by 'cleanup failure: ps read/exit budget exceeded 200 ms'; post identity pid 86694 was still stat Ss with ppid 1. The independent guardian later removed it, which cannot turn the candidate into a pass.
actionable_root_causes_and_fixes.fix: Keep the approved per-acquisition 200 ms cap but make cleanup resilient: retry a failed acquisition within the existing 3-second cleanup budget, or use an approved targeted identity query that is still fresh and birth-checked. Do not abort the entire cleanup after one transient miss. Track all observed descendants, not only identities already stopped, and ensure every retained descendant gets an identity-checked TERM/CONT/KILL attempt within the cleanup bound. Add a production-side transient-ps regression that verifies no leak.

actionable_root_causes_and_fixes.root_cause: tools/test_bounded_run.pl:44-68 table has the same one-shot 200 ms acquisition behavior. The independent guardian therefore aborted the required mutants run when one ps helper produced no bytes before the cap.
actionable_root_causes_and_fixes.actual_outcome: /tmp/7ad-aDDFvEvJ/results.json stopped after 15 clean cases with bytes=0, eof=0, status=unreaped. This was an actual outside-sandbox inspection failure, not a blanket sandbox denial: /tmp/iter80-M4-r7-native-ps-controls.json records four successful native ps controls in 20.266-23.234 ms.
actionable_root_causes_and_fixes.fix: Make the guardian retry a transient helper timeout within its finite independent budget and reap each helper before continuing. Keep denied/malformed inspections distinct from transient timeout. Rerun H mutants with approved clean-first; do not weaken the mutant assertions or count a cap/inspection failure as a kill.
